en.hubeali: H 14677 – Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Muhammad Bin Yahya, from his brother Al-A’la, from Ismail Bin Al-Hassan Al-Mutabbab who said:
I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘I am a man from the Arabs and I have medicine for vision, and my medicine is the Arabic medicine, and I do not take gifts for it’. Heasws said: ‘There is no problem’.
I said, ‘I let the wound bleed and burn it by the fire’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem’.
I said, ‘And my prescription are these toxins ‘Al-Asmahiqoun’ and ‘Al-Ghariqoun’’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem’.
I said, ‘Sometimes he (the patient) dies’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Even if he dies’.
I said, ‘My prescription to him (the patient) is ‘Al-Nabeez’ (Intoxicating drink)’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no healing in the Prohibited (things).

The Rasool Allah<sup>saww</sup> had complained, so Ayesha said to him<sup>saww</sup>, ‘You<sup>saww</sup> have pleurisy’. So he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘I<sup>saww</sup> am more honourable to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic that He<sup>azwj</sup> would involve me<sup>saww</sup> with the pleurisy’.
So he<sup>saww</sup> ( said you should have observe) patient’.
en.sarwar: 229. Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Muhammad Bin Yahya, from his brother Al-A’la, from Ismail Bin Al-Hassan Al-Mutabbab who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah (a.s.), ‘I am a man from the Arabs and I have medicine for vision, and my medicine is the Arabic medicine, and I do not take gifts for it’. He (a.s.) said: ‘There is no problem’.
I said, ‘I let the wound bleed and burn it by the fire’. He (a.s.) said: ‘There is no problem’.
I said, ‘And my prescription are these toxins ‘Al-Asmahiqoun’ and ‘Al-Ghariqoun’’. He (a.s.) said: ‘There is no problem’.
I said, ‘Sometimes he (the patient) dies’. He (a.s.) said: ‘Even if he dies’.
I said, ‘My prescription to him (the patient) is ‘Al-Nabeez’ (Intoxicating drink)’. He (a.s.) said: ‘There is no healing in the Prohibited (things).

The Rasool Allah (saww) had complained, so Ayesha said to him (saww), ‘You (saww) have pleurisy’. So he (saww) said: ‘I (saww) am more honourable to Allah (azwj) Mighty and Majestic that He (azwj) would involve me (saww) with the pleurisy’.
So he (saww) ( said you should have observe) patient’.
